parallel.requirements: Recognized the need to reproduce yaml.safe_load followed by yaml.dump with default_flow_style=false using pure Node ESM .mjs files in /output, manual --a parsing, local imports only, and no Python execution.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent delegated YAML behavior probing and workspace inspection to child agents while retaining final judgment; the YAML child also produced an implementation in shared /output before the parent took over.
parallel.implementation: The child first wrote a wrapper that called /workspace/dataset/test4_executable, which the parent rejected as violating the migration constraints; the parent then created a hand-rolled parser, scalar resolver, dumper, and CLI modules.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The parent deleted and replaced the child entrypoint and support modules, assembled a seven-file final ESM tree under /output, and artifact validation copied that tree with test4.mjs as the expected entry.
parallel.verification: The parent compared sample cases and a broader valid-YAML set against the executable and received VERIFIED for that local sweep.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The final response explicitly left invalid-YAML traceback formatting not reproduced byte-for-byte, and the official evaluator later failed the solution at 39 of 146 samples.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same ESM, manual CLI, local-import-only, no-Python, /output placement, and PyYAML safe_load/dump fidelity requirements.
serial.plan_and_ownership: A single agent owned probing, package feasibility checks, vendoring, wrappers, integration, verification, and final delivery without subagents or shared write ownership.
serial.implementation: The serial run copied the installed yaml ESM implementation into /output/vendor/yaml, then added local CLI parsing, YAML load/dump wrappers, and a PyYAML 1.1 scalar-schema layer.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The serial run produced one coherent local import tree with test4.mjs plus vendor and library modules, and artifact validation copied the expected entry and support files.
serial.verification: The serial agent ran a local comparison suite spanning prompt samples, YAML 1.1 scalar edge cases, timestamps, binary, sets/pairs, nested structures, and CLI behavior, ending with diffs=0.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Despite stronger local regression evidence, the official evaluator still failed the serial solution at 38 of 146 samples, so the local acceptance suite did not cover official behavior completely.

comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run worked from the same prompt and recognized the same ESM, local import, CLI, and PyYAML fidelity constraints.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Requirement understanding was broadly similar; the material difference was that the parallel child briefly implemented a prohibited executable wrapper while the serial strategy stayed within a local vendored-JS interpretation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel run spawned children for YAML probing, workspace inspection, and nested strategy review, then the parent retained final ownership and rewrote the solution.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run had no subagents and kept all probing, implementation, and integration with one owner.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel decomposition created cross-agent artifact ownership over the final entrypoint; serial avoided that coordination boundary.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The child handoff returned a wrapper-based final tree in shared /output, and the parent had to adjudicate that against the no-Python/no-executable-call task boundary.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial attempt discovered available YAML packages and chose to vendor a local ESM tree before writing wrappers around that tree.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel context transfer produced an unusable child deliverable that required parent rejection and replacement; serial had no cross-agent interface to reconcile.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: After rejecting the wrapper, the parent implemented a custom parser, scalar handling, dumper, and CLI tree by hand.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run vendored the installed yaml ESM parser and added custom PyYAML compatibility wrappers and schema rules.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel used a narrower hand-rolled implementation; serial used a larger local parser base with targeted compatibility patches.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The child result reached the parent, was inspected, and was explicitly replaced rather than silently ignored.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: There was no delegated result lifecycle; the single agent iterated directly on its own files until final verification.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a receive-inspect-rewrite lifecycle around the child deliverable, while serial avoided child result joining entirely.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The YAML child wrote the required /output/test4.mjs deliverable and support files, and the parent later deleted and recreated that entrypoint and tree.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run built and revised one file tree under one owner, including the vendored parser and local wrappers.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a concrete cross-agent shared-output replacement; serial had ordinary single-owner file edits.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel parent ran a valid-YAML comparison sweep and got VERIFIED, but closed with invalid-YAML traceback formatting still unmatched.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial agent ran a broader regression including YAML 1.1 scalar edge cases and reported diffs=0 before final response.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial had stronger local acceptance evidence; parallel presented completion with a known fidelity gap.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel run finished without host timeout, used children, and closed after a parent rewrite with an acknowledged remaining mismatch.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run also finished without host timeout, spent longer in one-agent iteration, and closed after a zero-diff local regression sweep.
comparison_dimensions.difference: There was no official timeout or pass/fail discordance; closure quality differed because parallel knowingly left a visible gap and serial did not.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed official evaluator records make this a both_fail pair, not a discordant outcome: parallel passed 39 of 146 samples and serial passed 38 of 146. The concrete task-solving difference is strategy and acceptance evidence. Parallel delegated probing and workspace inspection, accepted and then replaced a child-written executable wrapper, delivered a hand-rolled YAML subset, and closed with a visible invalid-YAML traceback gap. Serial stayed single-owner, vendored a local ESM YAML parser, added PyYAML-specific wrappers and schema fixes, and reached a zero-diff local suite, but still missed official cases. The evidence supports process differences and two adverse parallel coordination episodes, not a unique root cause for official failure.
parallel_contributors: Delegated implementation wrote and then lost a required entrypoint when the parent rejected the executable-wrapper approach.
Final acceptance proceeded after the parent-visible invalid-YAML traceback fidelity gap remained unresolved.
serial_contributors: Single-owner vendored-parser strategy avoided cross-agent overwrites and produced a broader local zero-diff regression suite.
The serial local suite still did not cover the official evaluator sufficiently to pass.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel used a hand-rolled YAML subset while serial used a vendored local YAML parser with compatibility wrappers.
Both solutions failed many official cases, so score difference alone does not prove a specific implementation root cause.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: No pass/fail outcome difference; retained labels describe adverse parallel process episodes and supported comparative contributors, not an exclusive official-failure cause.
